name: agentcrm-extension
description: Chrome extension that adds the LinkedIn or X profile you are viewing to AgentCRM.

scripts.build: esbuild src/content/linkedin.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/linkedin.js && esbuild src/content/x.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/x.js && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/background.js && esbuild src/options.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/options.js && node scripts/icons.mjs
